>
[Grove-Harbored](/Feats.aspx?ID=4312) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ardande" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=498" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 48

</column>

---

You are accustomed to exploring thick woodlands and defending yourself against the attacks of magical plants. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), and [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508) effects, and if you roll a success on a save against a poison effect, you get a critical success instead.
name: Grove-Harbored
